title: Not as originally pictured
text: Not as originally pictured. Picked this product bc I was looking for a rust colored curtain to add some color to our room. Online these curtains look rust color with a mustard color leaf pattern. Once received and hung up you see the color is more towards a burgundy with a pink tint when light shines through. Also these curtains have a glittery look throughout that I am not a fan of and the original pictures did not show that. Definitely would not have purchased if I knew the glittery look was there. The thickness of this curtain is disappointing as well, as even with our shades the light completely shines through. All around not super pleased with these curtains.

description: Elegant shimmering leaf design is brought to life on a textured, jacquard curtain valance accented with shiny Lurex yarn and a beaded trim. Includes (1) unlined 44" W x 19" L valance.
